verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents payout, settlement reporting, or reconciliation flows for agent-originated payments. The closest items are a passing TAP note that merchants can expect funds "when settlement occurs" and the description of a pass-through token for use at Visa-accepting merchants. These only imply that standard rails are used. They are not documented payout or reporting flows for this channel.

support.subject: As a merchant, agent-originated payments settle through documented payout and reporting flows, reconcilable like any other channel
